query.normalizedText: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC

findings.title: Sequential scan with an unindexed filter
findings.evidence: Seq Scan on orders filters customer_id (est. 8 of ~200000 rows, total cost 2941.59).

validation.label: Planner-validated (HypoPG estimate): total cost 3943 → 53 (−98.7%). Estimate from the planner, not a runtime measurement.

valueRange.label: Across 4 sampled values of orders.customer_id (HypoPG planner estimates): −56.6% for a common value of orders.customer_id (1.9% of rows), up to −98.8% (generic plan: −98.7%, which is what the ranking uses).

footprint.label: Estimated index size 4.4 MB (HypoPG estimate), ≈39% of the table's 11.5 MB — every write to the indexed columns also maintains it.
